description:
To perform Qualification, Nitrate Calibration, Validation of One Argo float or One Glider by using Neural Network and Climatology.
Copy past before running and change calibration parametrization if necessary

## Associated Tutorial

This workflows is part of the tutorial [Nitrate DMQC for autonomous platforms such as Argo floats](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/climate/tutorials/ocean_qcv_analysis/tutorial.html), available in the [GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org)
